description.en: Generic original composite-volcano geological form informed by NPS primary composite-volcano explanation and actual AVO/USGS Iliamna field photograph. No exact named edifice, DEM, eruption simulation, age or coexisting ecosystem. Nominal6000x5400x2250m illustrative art-planning module, not measured Iliamna.
